1.consolidated_definition: Planta subleñosa, carnosa, recta, que vegeta a orillas del mar y florece casi perenne; llega a un metro de altura; sus flores son blancas. (Scaevola plumieri; Lobelia plumeria). Stahl, Catalog, 6:31.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial succulent plant with a straight stem that grows near the sea and blooms almost year-round; it reaches a height of one meter; its flowers are white. (Scaevola plumieri; Lobelia plumeria). Stahl, Catalog, 6:31.
